changes.before: 这个系列一层一层看笑：躲猫猫里婴儿的趋向（12DD）；13DD 笑第一次有了主人，“这一判是我的”；14DD 自己的目的进入所笑之构，有得意之笑与苦笑，也有嘲笑和用笑做事；15DD 的不疑，绝望之笑与会心之笑。它在相视而笑（16DD）之前停下，只登记，不展开。在这个意义上，笑论是美学系列的背面。
changes.after: 这个系列一层一层看笑：躲猫猫里婴儿的趋向（12DD）；13DD 笑第一次有了主人，“这一判是我的”；14DD 自己的目的进入所笑之构，有得意之笑与苦笑，也有嘲笑和用笑做事；15DD 的不疑，绝望之笑与会心之笑。它也触及两个人怎样在一次相遇中彼此承认为目的；那仍是双方各自的 15DD 瞬间，不是完整的 16DD。在这个意义上，笑论是美学系列的背面。

changes.before: The series follows laughter layer by layer: the tendency of an infant at peek-a-boo (12DD); the owner who arrives at 13DD, “this judgment is mine”; purpose entering the construct laughed at (14DD), with the laughter of triumph and wry laughter, derision, and doing things with laughter; and the non dubito of 15DD, the laughter of despair and the knowing smile. It stops before looking at each other and laughing (16DD), which it registers only. In this sense it is the reverse side of the aesthetics series.
changes.after: The series follows laughter layer by layer: the tendency of an infant at peek-a-boo (12DD); the owner who arrives at 13DD, “this judgment is mine”; purpose entering the construct laughed at (14DD), with the laughter of triumph and wry laughter, derision, and doing things with laughter; and the non dubito of 15DD, the laughter of despair and the knowing smile. It also touches on two people recognizing each other as ends in a particular encounter. These remain their respective 15DD moments, not complete 16DD. In this sense it is the reverse side of the aesthetics series.

changes.before: 辖域起于 12DD（11DD 并入），止于 15DD。挠痒的笑要分两段：手还没碰到，孩子已经笑了，预测的是别人的动作，属 12DD 的趋向；碰到之后的那一笑，属 10DD 的感知之笑，在下界之外。上界之外是 16DD：两个主体彼此不疑时的相视而笑。笑论只登记它，不展开。
changes.after: 辖域起于 12DD（11DD 并入），主线止于 15DD。挠痒的笑要分两段：手还没碰到，孩子已经笑了，预测的是别人的动作，属 12DD 的趋向；碰到之后的那一笑，属 10DD 的感知之笑，在下界之外。两个人若在一次相视而笑中彼此承认为目的，仍是各自的 15DD 瞬间。完整的 16DD 要求双向不疑贯穿所有事情；有限个体不能凭这一刻宣告抵达。这里保留这一理想极限，不展开它。

changes.before: The scope begins at 12DD, with 11DD merged in, and ends at 15DD. Tickling laughter has to be split in two: before the hand touches, the child is already laughing, predicting another’s movement, a 12DD tendency; the laugh after contact is 10DD perceptual laughter, beyond the lower bound. Beyond the upper bound lies 16DD: looking at each other and laughing, when two subjects do not doubt each other. The series registers it only, without developing it.
changes.after: The scope begins at 12DD, with 11DD merged in, and its main line ends at 15DD. Tickling laughter has to be split in two: before the hand touches, the child is already laughing, predicting another’s movement, a 12DD tendency; the laugh after contact is 10DD perceptual laughter, beyond the lower bound. If two people recognize each other as ends in a particular shared laugh, these remain their respective 15DD moments. Complete 16DD would require mutual non dubito across every matter; finite persons cannot claim it on the strength of this encounter. That ideal limit is left undeveloped here.

changes.before: 迦叶破颜微笑，是迦叶到了世尊所在之处；按论文，这一笑还让世尊所在之处仍是世尊的，不疑凡到了这一步的人都会这样见。这一笑是单向的：原文只记迦叶微笑，没有记世尊笑，也没有两人相视而笑的明文。世尊随后付法，若读作对迦叶的确认，用的也是话，是付法，不是两人对着笑；它是否构成双向不疑，属 16DD，笑论不判。
changes.after: 迦叶破颜微笑，是迦叶到了世尊所在之处；按论文，这一笑还让世尊所在之处仍是世尊的，不疑凡到了这一步的人都会这样见。这一笑是单向的：原文只记迦叶微笑，没有记世尊笑，也没有两人相视而笑的明文。世尊随后付法，若读作对迦叶的确认，用的也是话，是付法，不是两人对着笑。即使把这里读作双方在这一件事上彼此承认为目的，也仍是两人各自的 15DD 瞬间，不能据此认定完整的 16DD；这则记载没有替他们在所有事情上的关系作证。

changes.before: Mahākāśyapa’s breaking into a smile is his arriving where the World-Honoured One was; on the paper’s reading, the smile also lets that place remain the World-Honoured One’s, not doubting that whoever reaches this point would see it so. The smile is unidirectional: the original records only Mahākāśyapa’s smile, not that the World-Honoured One smiled, and nothing explicit about the two looking at each other and laughing. The transmission that follows, if read as a confirmation of Mahākāśyapa, is done in words, by handing on the Dharma, not by two people laughing at each other; whether it amounts to mutual non dubito belongs to 16DD, and the series does not judge it.
changes.after: Mahākāśyapa’s breaking into a smile is his arriving where the World-Honoured One was; on the paper’s reading, the smile also lets that place remain the World-Honoured One’s, not doubting that whoever reaches this point would see it so. The smile is unidirectional: the original records only Mahākāśyapa’s smile, not that the World-Honoured One smiled, and nothing explicit about the two looking at each other and laughing. The transmission that follows, if read as a confirmation of Mahākāśyapa, is done in words, by handing on the Dharma, not by two people laughing at each other. Even if we read this as reciprocal recognition in this particular matter, it remains their respective 15DD moments, not evidence of complete 16DD. The account does not establish their relation across every matter.

changes.before: 两个人在同一处笑，可以是三件不同的事。同笑一事：两个主体各自判、各自笑，判断各是各的，各按各自所站之层计，在辖域之内。心照不宣：同笑一事，再加上共同知识，我知道你知道，你也知道我知道；仍各按各的层计。相视而笑：双向不疑，两人互以对方为目的；在笑上，是我不怀疑你会笑，你也不怀疑我会笑。那是 16DD，在辖域之外。
changes.after: 两个人在同一处笑，可以是三件不同的事。同笑一事：两个主体各自判、各自笑，判断各是各的，各按各自所站之层计。心照不宣：同笑一事，再加上共同知识，我知道你知道，你也知道我知道；仍各按各的层计。还有一种可以进一步读为彼此承认的相视而笑：不只知道对方懂了，也让对方作为目的留在自己面前。不过，共同的笑声不独自证明这一姿态；即使这一刻双方确实彼此如此，也仍是两个 15DD 瞬间，不是完整的 16DD。

changes.before: Two people laughing at the same point can be doing three different things. Laughing at the same thing: two subjects each judge and each laugh; each judgment is their own, each counted at the layer where each stands, within the scope. Tacit understanding: laughing at the same thing plus common knowledge, I know that you know and you know that I know; still each at their own layer. Looking at each other and laughing: mutual non dubito, each taking the other as an end; in laughter, I do not doubt that you will laugh, and you do not doubt that I will. That is 16DD, outside the scope.
changes.after: Two people laughing at the same point can be doing three different things. Laughing at the same thing: two subjects each judge and each laugh; each judgment is their own, each counted at the layer where each stands. Tacit understanding adds common knowledge: I know that you know, and you know that I know; still each at their own layer. There is also a shared laugh that we may read further as reciprocal recognition: not just knowing that the other understands, but letting the other remain an end. Shared laughter does not itself prove this stance. Even where both take it toward each other in that moment, these remain two 15DD moments, not complete 16DD.

changes.before: 「不疑也不是预测。」“他每次都会笑”是对行为的把握；相视而笑里说的“会笑”，指的是心里的笑，那一下不得不，不是动作。别人心里那一下，不能由我替他经历；我看到的表情、我作的推测，也不替他认领它。我可以听他的报告，并让它纠正我的理解；这里说的不疑，是不以自己的预期占掉那个位置，也就是承认。所以说我不怀疑你会笑，是承认你心里那一下是你的。你外面没笑，碰不着它；你若说心里没笑，我照你的话，也不判你没看见。不疑一个只能由对方自己经历的感受，就是承认对方是这个感受的主体；两人互相这样承认，是互以对方为目的在笑上的样子。论文明说，把这种不代写连到完整的目的关系，是笑论的主张，是否充分仍待论证。
changes.after: 「不疑也不是预测。」“他每次都会笑”是对行为的把握，不能推出“他者也是目的”。别人心里那一下，我也不能替他经历；看到的表情和自己的推测，都不替他认领它。我可以听他的报告，让它纠正我的理解。你外面没笑，不等于心里没有；你若说心里没笑，我也不该为了保住自己的读法，硬说你其实笑了，或判你没看见。这里要保留的，是你的经验仍由你来说明。不代写这一经验，是承认你为主体的一种做法，却还不能独自证明已经把你作为目的，更不能从“我不怀疑你会笑”跳到完整的目的关系。把这些联系说清楚，仍是笑论需要继续承担的工作。

changes.before: “Nor is non dubito prediction.” “He laughs every time” is a grasp of behaviour; the “will laugh” in looking at each other and laughing refers to inner laughter, the jolt of cannot-not, not to a movement. The jolt within another person cannot be lived through by me in his stead; the expression I see and the guesses I make do not claim it for him either. I can hear his report and let it correct my understanding; non dubito here means not letting my own expectation occupy that place, which is to say acknowledgment. So to say I do not doubt that you will laugh is to acknowledge that the jolt within you is yours. If you do not laugh outwardly, that does not touch it; if you say you did not laugh within, I take your word for it, and I do not judge that you failed to see. Not doubting a feeling that only the other can live through is acknowledging the other as the subject of that feeling; two people acknowledging each other in this way is how each taking the other as an end shows itself in laughter. The paper says plainly that linking this abstention from writing the other’s feeling in for him to the full relation of mutual ends is a claim of the series, and whether it suffices is still to be argued.
changes.after: “Nor is non dubito prediction.” “He laughs every time” is a grasp of behaviour, not a demonstration that the other is an end. Nor can I live through another person’s inner laughter in their stead; the expression I see and the guesses I make do not claim it for them. I can hear their account and let it correct my understanding. Not laughing outwardly does not establish an absence of inner laughter. If you say you did not laugh inwardly, I should not protect my interpretation by insisting that you really did, or by declaring that you failed to see. Your experience remains yours to describe. Not writing that experience for you is one way of acknowledging you as a subject, but it does not by itself establish that I treat you as an end. Still less can “I do not doubt that you will laugh” establish a complete relation of mutual ends. Clarifying these connections remains work for the theory of laughter.

changes.before: 会心之笑与相视而笑，正好跨在 15DD 与 16DD 的线上：会心之笑是单向的不疑，不要求对方回头；相视而笑是双向的。《庄子·大宗师》里有这一笑的样子。子祀、子舆、子犁、子来四人相与语曰：「孰能以无为首，以生为脊，以死为尻，孰知死生存亡之一体者，吾与之友矣。」「四人相视而笑，莫逆于心，遂相与为友。」按论文的读法：先是各自懂了那一问；“相视”是两边的笑在那一眼里相遇；“莫逆于心”是心意无违，承的正是双向不疑；“遂相与为友”，是 16DD 的关系由此立起来。笑论把它登记在上界之外，不展开。
changes.after: 会心之笑不要求对方回头；相视而笑若还包含彼此承认，则是两个主体各自在这一刻采取不疑的立场。差别在这一刻是否彼此相遇，不是从 15DD 升到了 16DD。《庄子·大宗师》里有一幅可以这样读的画面。子祀、子舆、子犁、子来四人相与语曰：「孰能以无为首，以生为脊，以死为尻，孰知死生存亡之一体者，吾与之友矣。」「四人相视而笑，莫逆于心，遂相与为友。」沿论文的读法，先是各自懂了那一问；“相视”让他们的笑在目光里相遇；“莫逆于心”与“遂相与为友”，使读者能够继续想这种相遇怎样成为友谊。但这一幕不能证明，他们此后在所有事情上都完全不疑彼此为目的。按本站冻结定义，它至多可以被试读为各自的 15DD 瞬间相接，不认证完整的 16DD。

changes.before: The knowing smile and looking at each other and laughing sit exactly astride the line between 15DD and 16DD: the knowing smile is unidirectional non dubito and does not require the other to turn back; looking at each other and laughing is mutual. Zhuangzi’s chapter “The Great and Venerable Teacher” shows what this laugh looks like. Zisi, Ziyu, Zili and Zilai were talking together and said: “Who can take non-being as his head, life as his spine and death as his rump? Who knows that death and life, survival and perishing, are all one body? We will be his friends.” “The four looked at one another and laughed, with no disagreement in their hearts, and so they became friends.” On the paper’s reading: first each understood the question; “looked at one another” is the two sides’ laughter meeting in that glance; “no disagreement in their hearts” carries exactly mutual non dubito; and “so they became friends” is a 16DD relation being founded on it. The series registers it beyond the upper bound, and does not develop it.
changes.after: The knowing smile does not require the other to turn back. If looking at each other and laughing also involves reciprocal recognition, each subject takes the stance of non dubito in this particular moment. The difference is whether they meet each other here, not a promotion from 15DD to 16DD. Zhuangzi’s chapter “The Great and Venerable Teacher” offers a scene we can read this way. Zisi, Ziyu, Zili and Zilai were talking together and said: “Who can take non-being as his head, life as his spine and death as his rump? Who knows that death and life, survival and perishing, are all one body? We will be his friends.” “The four looked at one another and laughed, with no disagreement in their hearts, and so they became friends.” Following the paper’s reading, each first understood the question; their laughter meets in that glance; their accord and ensuing friendship let us ask how such an encounter can become a friendship. But the scene does not establish that they remain unwavering, across every matter, that each other is an end. Under this site’s frozen definitions, it can at most be tried as a meeting of their respective 15DD moments, not a certification of complete 16DD.

changes.before: 第三层在两人之间：那一刻两人都不疑对方是目的。笑话说的是“疑”，你会关掉手电筒；一起笑出来的却是不疑：我不怀疑你会笑，你也不怀疑我会笑。小丑的方向要靠把别人当材料来维持，这挡掉了他的绝望之笑；那一刻他对蝙蝠侠这个人的不疑，对象不同，不疑是对象特异的，所以不相抵。这一例只作示意，不作证明：一阵笑可以分份，各份各按其层记；自嘲与绝望之笑可以在同一阵笑里并存；第四条挡掉的，是一个要靠否认他人来维持的方向；相视而笑可以把 13DD 与 15DD 的笑包在同一阵笑声里。16DD 本身，仍只登记，不展开。
changes.after: 第三层在两人之间，仍以那个额外的读法为前提：假如那一刻两人确实彼此承认为目的，它是双方各自的 15DD 瞬间。笑话讲的是“疑”，担心对方关掉手电筒；共同的笑声可以让我们试着看另一种相遇，却不能替这份承认作证。小丑的方向要靠把别人当材料来维持，这挡掉了他的绝望之笑；对蝙蝠侠这个具体他者的一时姿态，若按上述前提来读，是另一项需要分别判断的事，不能拿它替小丑整个方向开免责证明。这一例只作示意，不作证明：一阵笑可以分份，各份各按其层记；自嘲与绝望之笑可以在同一阵笑里并存；第四条挡掉的，是一个要靠否认他人来维持的方向。相视而笑可以容纳不同的笑，也可能伴有彼此承认，但不因此多出一个 16DD 的认证。

changes.before: The third layer lies between the two: at that moment neither doubts that the other is an end. The joke is about doubt, that you would switch off the flashlight; yet what they laugh out together is non dubito: I do not doubt that you will laugh, and you do not doubt that I will. That the Joker’s direction must be sustained by treating others as material rules out his laughter of despair; his non dubito at that moment toward Batman as a person has a different object, and non dubito is object-specific, so the two do not cancel out. The example illustrates and does not prove: a burst of laughter can be divided into shares, each recorded at its own layer; self-mockery and the laughter of despair can coexist in one burst; what the fourth condition rules out is a direction that must be sustained by denying others; and looking at each other and laughing can wrap 13DD and 15DD laughs in a single burst. 16DD itself is still registered only, not developed.
changes.after: The third layer lies between them, still conditional on the additional reading proposed above: if each really does recognize the other as an end at that moment, these are their respective 15DD moments. The joke is about doubt, the fear that the other will switch off the flashlight. Their shared laughter lets us try another way of reading their encounter, but does not prove recognition. The Joker’s direction depends on treating others as material, which rules out his laughter of despair. His momentary stance toward Batman, if we accept the proposed premise, is a separate matter to judge; it does not excuse his direction as a whole. The example illustrates and does not prove: different laughs can be distinguished within one burst; self-mockery and the laughter of despair can coexist; the fourth condition excludes a direction that requires denying others. A shared laugh can hold different laughs and may accompany reciprocal recognition, without certifying 16DD.

changes.before: 笑论从 12DD 的趋向开始，经过 13DD 的主人、14DD 的目的，到 15DD 的不疑。从 13DD 起，笑判的都是“构还有这么一个余项”，都是谁都没输；12DD 只具其趋向材料。到相视而笑这里，笑不再只是一个人的判断，而是两个主体之间的不疑。笑论在此停下，把它留作自己的一个大余项。
changes.after: 笑论从 12DD 的趋向开始，经过 13DD 的主人、14DD 的目的，到 15DD 的不疑。从 13DD 起，笑判的都是“构还有这么一个余项”，都是谁都没输；12DD 只具其趋向材料。相视而笑又让我们问：两个各自判断的主体，怎样在一件事上彼此承认，而不把对方收进自己的判断？这仍可以在两个 15DD 瞬间里发生。至于这种双向不疑贯穿所有事情的完整 16DD，笑论不凭一次相遇宣告实现，把它留作自己的一个大余项。

changes.before: The Laughter Series begins with the tendency of 12DD and passes through the owner of 13DD and the purpose of 14DD to the non dubito of 15DD. From 13DD on, what laughter judges is always “the construct still has such a remainder,” and in every case no one loses; 12DD has only the material of its tendency. At looking at each other and laughing, laughter is no longer one person’s judgment alone but non dubito between two subjects. The series stops here, and leaves it as one large remainder of its own.
changes.after: The Laughter Series begins with the tendency of 12DD and passes through the owner of 13DD and the purpose of 14DD to the non dubito of 15DD. From 13DD on, what laughter judges is always “the construct still has such a remainder,” and in every case no one loses; 12DD has only the material of its tendency. A shared laugh raises another question: how can two subjects, each judging for themselves, recognize each other in a particular matter without absorbing the other into their judgment? This can still occur as two 15DD moments. Complete 16DD, mutual non dubito across every matter, is not established by an encounter; the theory leaves it as one large remainder of its own.

changes.before: 回到开头的两次笑。那个认定没有了的人，看见自己还在找，那份认定没有被推翻，寻找者也没有被抹掉；那个终于懂了父亲的人，到了父亲早已所在之处，让那地方仍是父亲的。两次笑都只是一个人的笑，谁也没有要求另一位回过头来。相视而笑，在它们之后。
changes.after: 回到开头的两次笑。那个认定没有了的人，看见自己还在找，那份认定没有被推翻，寻找者也没有被抹掉；那个终于懂了父亲的人，到了父亲早已所在之处，让那地方仍是父亲的。两次笑都只是一个人的笑，谁也没有要求另一位回过头来。它们也可能在一次具体相遇中彼此相接，却不因此多出一个可以宣告抵达的等级。

changes.before: Back to the two laughs at the beginning. The one convinced there was nothing left sees himself still searching; the conviction is not overturned, and the seeker is not erased. The one who finally understood his father has arrived where his father long stood, and lets that place remain his father’s. Both laughs are one person’s laughter; neither asks anyone to turn back. Looking at each other and laughing comes after them.
changes.after: Back to the two laughs at the beginning. The one convinced there was nothing left sees himself still searching; the conviction is not overturned, and the seeker is not erased. The one who finally understood his father has arrived where his father long stood, and lets that place remain his father’s. Both laughs are one person’s laughter; neither asks anyone to turn back. Such stances may meet in a particular encounter, without producing a new level that a relationship can claim to have reached.

changes.before: 两个人为同一份失去哭，各判各的，是同哭一事；再加上彼此知道，是心照不宣；两人互以对方为目的，是相拥而泣，在 16DD，专论只登记，不展开。相拥、同步流泪、彼此知道对方的失去，都不独自认证 16DD。笑论第四篇在相视而笑之前停下；专论在相拥而泣之前停下。
changes.after: 两个人为同一份失去哭，各判各的，是同哭一事；再加上彼此知道，是心照不宣；若两人还在这一刻彼此承认为目的，相拥而泣也可以被读为两个主体各自的 15DD 瞬间。但相拥、同步流泪、知道对方的失去，都不能独自证明这份承认，更不能认证完整的 16DD。后者要求双向不疑贯穿所有事情，是有限个体面对的理想极限。笑论第四篇与这篇专论都把一次具体相遇留给读者分辨，不凭共同的笑声或眼泪，宣告一段关系已经抵达。

changes.before: Two people weeping over the same loss, each judging on his own, is weeping at the same thing; add that each knows of the other, and it is tacit understanding; where each takes the other as an end, it is embracing and weeping, at 16DD, which the special study registers only and does not develop. Embracing, weeping in step, and each knowing the other’s loss do not on their own certify 16DD. Paper IV of the Laughter Series stopped before looking at each other and laughing; the special study stops before embracing and weeping.
changes.after: Two people weeping over the same loss, each judging for themselves, are weeping at the same thing; add mutual knowledge, and there is tacit understanding. If they also recognize each other as ends in this moment, embracing and weeping may be read as their respective 15DD moments. But an embrace, tears in step, and knowledge of the other’s loss do not by themselves prove recognition, still less certify complete 16DD. The latter would require mutual non dubito across every matter, an ideal limit for finite persons. Both the fourth laughter essay and this special study leave the particular encounter open to judgment, rather than declaring a relationship complete on the strength of shared laughter or tears.

added_notes.en: Terminology note: this reader edition follows the site’s frozen 13–16DD definitions. Reciprocal non dubito in a particular encounter remains two subjects’ respective 15DD moments. Complete 16DD would require mutual non dubito across every matter: an ideal limit for finite persons, not a level certified by an encounter. Where the linked papers register momentary recognition as 16DD, this edition uses that distinction instead. Shared laughter or weeping does not itself establish recognition.
added_notes.zh: 用语说明：本系列沿用本站13–16DD冻结表。一次具体相遇中的相互不疑，按两个主体各自的15DD瞬间理解；16DD仅指在所有事情上完整的双向不疑，是有限个体面对的理想极限。所链接论文把个别瞬间互认登记为16DD的地方，本散文版据此校准；也不因两个人一起笑或哭，就判定互认已经发生。
